about_the_game:
The Twitch Integrated Throwing System is the ultimate chaos machine for streamers who want to make their broadcasts more interactive, funny, and unforgettable.

Built for VTubers using VTube Studio or VSeeFace, but just as fun for PNGTubers and facecam streamers, this software turns your stream into a fully interactive overlay where your viewers can literally throw the action at you.

React to follows, subs, cheers, donations, and more with flying objects, custom sound effects, physics-based chaos, and hilarious on-stream moments. Whether it’s plushies, pies, trucks, books, or completely cursed custom creations, your chat can turn every alert into entertainment.

Key Features

🎯 Reacts To Your Stream Events
Connect your alerts and trigger reactions for follows, subscriptions, cheers, donations, and more. Set up custom responses that launch virtual objects, activate animations, play sounds, or create full event sequences in real time.

🌐 Multi-Platform Support
Designed to work with multiple streaming platforms and tools, including Twitch, YouTube, Streamlabs, Pulsoid, and now StreamElements support. Build one chaos system around the platforms you already use.

🎨 Import Your Own Assets
Bring your stream to life with your own content. Import:

  • Sound effects

  • 3D models

  • PNGs & GIFs

  • VRM avatars

  • Emotes

  • and more

Create a setup that matches your stream’s style, humor, and branding.

🛠 Customize Your Throwables
Fine-tune how your items behave with options for:

  • Size

  • Physics

  • Bounce

  • Knockback

  • Spawn rules

  • Sticky behavior

  • and more

From tiny plushies to screen-filling disasters, you’re in control.

🤖 Built-In Event Manager
Create more than simple alerts. Use the built-in event tools to design layered reactions, chained effects, and more complex interactive behavior for truly unique on-stream moments.

📺 Adapts To Your Setup
Whether you stream with VTube Studio, VSeeFace, PNGTubers, or a traditional facecam, the Twitch Integrated Throwing System fits right into your content setup.

🎯 Dynamic Hitbox Tracking
For supported VTuber setups, the system can track your model dynamically, helping thrown items interact in a more believable and entertaining way.

📦 Ready To Use, Easy To Expand
Get started quickly with included default items, then expand your library with your own custom assets and reactions as your stream evolves.

💡 Easy To Use, Hard To Survive
With an intuitive setup and flexible customization, it’s easy to build interactive chaos without turning your workflow into a mess.

Turn your stream into chaos.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2015 or newer) / Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Pro / Apple M1 GPU or better
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 @ 3.7 GHz (2 cores) or equivalent
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated DX11-capable (e.g. Intel HD 620) with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
